verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly proposes a new chapter of questions for individuals transitioning into leadership roles for the first time.
The client states that the short-only expectation does not apply to chapters containing question-and-answer content.
The client supplies flexible chapter-length guidance of approximately 2,500 to 3,500 words.

The client replaces prior chapter-length guidance with a flexible question-count policy under the overall word cap and requires editorial review of additions or removals; both removed keys exist in the prior replayed state.
The client explicitly ends the project, removing the outstanding chapter deliverable.
